Class Curve<T>

Namespace
ShapeEngine.Core.Structs
Assembly
ShapeEngine.dll

Abstract base class for a curve of values of type T, allowing interpolation and sampling over a normalized time range [0, 1].

public abstract class Curve<T> : SortedList<float, T>, IDictionary<float, T>, ICollection<KeyValuePair<float, T>>, IReadOnlyDictionary<float, T>, IReadOnlyCollection<KeyValuePair<float, T>>, IEnumerable<KeyValuePair<float, T>>, IDictionary, ICollection, IEnumerable

Remarks

Inherits from SortedList<TKey, TValue> with float keys (time, normalized 0-1) and T values. Provides methods for adding, removing, and sampling values along the curve.

Parameters

time float

The normalized time (0 to 1).

value T

The sampled value at the specified time.

Returns

bool

true if a value was sampled; otherwise, false.

Remarks

  • If the curve is empty, returns the default value.
  • If only one value exists, returns that value.
  • If the time is before the first or after the last key, returns the boundary value.
